claude_proposed_widenings.name: ApplyConditionOperation
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: OngoingOperation only has roll_modifier and damage_on_hit. Greater Invisibility's core mechanic is applying a named condition to a creature for the spell's duration — neither existing variant captures this. The apply_condition v4 atom already exists but has no OngoingOperation surface path.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: A creature you touch has the Invisible condition until the spell ends.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: Condition: "invisible"
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The Condition type currently contains only "prone". The Invisible condition is a distinct SRD condition (Rules Glossary) required to represent this spell's effect and is mechanically significant (attackers have Advantage vs. the target, the target has Advantage on its attack rolls).

discrepancies: no content/greater_invisibility.json authored; accepted self-report-only widening path
